value_blindness: committed before any E-MTAB-10283 read was converted or counted and before any KLF12 value of any candidate reference was read; only BAM header and raw read-structure statistics (tag lengths, N positions, quality alphabet) of the first ~200,000 records of a partial download were inspected
kind_of_change: INPUT RECONSTRUCTION ROUTE only; replaces amendment 17's bamtofastq step, whose gate failed. No rule, criterion, layer, quantity or derivation changes
gate_result_amendment_17: FAILED as written: the ENA BAMs are not Cell Ranger BAMs but ENA's unaligned FASTQ packaging (@PG fastq_pre_barcodes --read1 <R2> --index1 <R1> --umi_read index1 --umi_offset 16 --umi_size 12 --cell_read index1 --cell_offset 0 --cell_size 16 --index2 <I1> --sample_read index2 --sample_offset 0 --sample_size 8, then samtools); no @SQ, no 10x @RG/@CO; bamtofastq cannot convert it (not run). No original Cell Ranger version exists in the header

losslessness_evidence.tags: every inspected record is unmapped (flag 4) with SEQ/QUAL 91/91 (R2), CR/CY 16/16 (cell barcode and qualities), RX/QX 12/12 (UMI and qualities), BC/QT 8/8 (sample index and qualities), on (original Illumina read name, '@' in place of the space), op (== QUAL in 200,000/200,000 records)
losslessness_evidence.RX_QX_raw: established as the original uncorrected UMI and qualities: the @PG chain has only the extraction (UMI = R1 bases 17-28) and a samtools conversion, no correction step; CR is uncorrected (301/200,000 barcodes contain N, which correction removes); N calls are cycle-specific (cycles 1, 2, 4, 8; none after cycle 8), so zero N in the UMI (cycles 17-28) is expected of raw reads; qualities are the raw binned alphabet (',', ':', 'F'); no CB/UB corrected tags

reconstruction.source: each ENA BAM after its local md5 and size equal ENA's published values (amendment 17)
reconstruction.tool: the pinned Cell Ranger 9.0.1's bundled samtools (lib/bin/samtools) `view`, a deterministic text transform, and pigz
reconstruction.R1: sequence = CR + RX (16 + 12 = 28 bases); quality = CY + QX
reconstruction.names: the original read name from `on` (text before '@'), with comments '1:N:0:<index>' (R1), '2:N:0:<index>' (R2) and '1:N:0:<index>' (I1) taken from `on` after '@'; identical names in R1/R2/I1 for each record
reconstruction.requirements: every record must have exactly these tags and lengths (R1 28, R2 91, I1 8); the number of reconstructed reads must equal ENA read_count (ERR5545549: 400,248,540; ERR5545551: 387,051,041); any violation stops C4
reconstruction.records: the reconstructed FASTQs are recorded by sha256, uncompressed-content sha256 and read count as intermediates; the provenance sidecar still names the BAMs with computed and published md5 (amendment 17)

cross_check: the ArrayExpress FASTQs are not downloaded unless the reconstruction exposes an ambiguity
count: unchanged from amendment 17: the pinned stack of amendment 16 at the amendment-13 count settings, one library at a time
unchanged: every rule of amendments 01-17 other than amendment 17's bamtofastq step: the pinned stack and filtered-count layer, QC, candidate, donor and population rules, count_per_10k, the derivation and every constant, variants, stopping and verdict rules, amendment 15's endpoint role, the amendment-05 frozen C5 citation and the owner's B1/B2 resolution. No code changes; amendment 12's pins are carried verbatim
review_provenance: the cross-vendor independent reviewer is unavailable; review is degraded and no independent cross-vendor review is claimed
implementation_pin_authority: amendment 12; this amendment carries its pinned_implementation_sha256 verbatim

frozen_threshold_derivation_citation.rule: at C5 the definition file's threshold_derivation is exactly this string, byte for byte; any other value is a deviation. It must pass Phase 2A RR14's repository-citation check (_repository_citation) against the frozen definition pre-registration

candidate_selection.rule: qualification.select(inventory, min_reference_donors=3): metadata-only D1/D2/D5/D8 qualification, then the D7 order
candidate_selection.fallthrough: a VALUE-BLIND failure of the selected candidate (retrieval checksum, pipeline reproduction, reprocessing, donor-label join, fewer than min_reference_donors donors with cells) passes to the next candidate in the frozen order; a VALUE-AWARE failure (derive() returns NO_STABLE_SEPARATION) never does, because trying candidates until one separates would select a reference by its KLF12 distribution
candidate_selection.next_candidates: none: C03 is the only metadata-qualified candidate

rr14_citations.evidence_citation: E-MTAB-10283 (the reference dataset the state separation is measured in), evidence_kind reference_state_separation
rr14_citations.comparability_evidence: doi:10.5281/zenodo.17412607 (the ADOC pipeline code and lock file) together with the committed stack-identification result

verdict_rules: NO_SUITABLE_REFERENCE: no candidate qualifies on metadata; or every qualified candidate fails a value-blind check that is not a comparability failure; or derive() returns NO_STABLE_SEPARATION
BLOCKED_COMPARABILITY: no Cell Ranger stack passes the stack-identification test, or the pinned stack cannot process the selected candidate and no later candidate exists
BLOCKED_OWNER_DECISION: derive() qualifies but a requirement needs an owner decision not yet taken (owner acceptance under RR12, or activation of config/personalization.yaml)

QUALIFIED_REFERENCE_FOUND: derive() qualifies and phase2a_contract.evaluate_reference, run on the committed reference files with the manifest named in memory, reports no RR01-RR12 or RR14 failure other than the RR10 activation clause that only the owner's activation commit can satisfy; it enables assumption_conditioned_scenario mapping only, RR13 stays unmet, and no donor-specific model is produced
